## Support for Java Applets


testRigor now supports testing applications that use Java Applets, expanding its automation capabilities to include legacy Java-based applications.


With this update, users can incorporate Java Applets into their automated testing workflows, making it easier to validate applications that rely on this technology.


## Generating Tests Based on a Jira Ticket


We’ve introduced a new way to generate test cases using Jira tickets.


When generating a test case from a description, users can now attach a Jira ticket as a reference. testRigor will use the ticket’s description to automatically generate a test case based on its requirements.


## Automatic Test Data Updates in Live Mode


Live Mode sessions now automatically update global variables and dataset variables when their values are modified during a session.


This enhancement ensures that changes made to test data during Live Mode are automatically reflected in the corresponding variables, eliminating the need for starting a new live mode session when making such changes.
